findings.text: Each generic header in this lane uses a single include guard macro that is defined on first inclusion to suppress repeated processing. The guard carries no runtime behavior, locking or state.
User range checking is entered through inline helper __access_ok taking a user pointer and length, and through macro access_ok which forwards to it with a likely success hint.

Validation succeeds unconditionally when alternate user address space support is enabled or when memory management is disabled. Otherwise it succeeds only when the length fits inside the task limit and the start address leaves enough room without wrapping past that limit, making the test safe against overflow.
TASK_SIZE_MAX equals TASK_SIZE.
BITS_PER_LONG is 64 in one build configuration and 32 in the alternate, while BITS_PER_LONG_LONG is always 64.
Predicate small_const_nbits reports true only for a compile time constant bit count that is positive and no larger than BITS_PER_LONG, selecting optimized constant paths.

Warning state uses bit 0 for warning, bit 1 for once, bit 2 for done, bit 3 for no cut marker and bit 4 for arguments present. A taint code is stored shifted left by 8 and recovered by shifting right by 8. Output uses a fixed cut here separator line.

Record bug_entry stores a fault address, optional format and file with line number, and a flags half word. Address and pointer members use direct storage in one mode and relative displacement in the other, and file details exist only under verbose bug reporting while format exists only with arch bug format support.
Macro BUG never returns. One configuration prints file line and function context then panics, the minimal configuration spins in a trap loop. Optimizers treat the path as unreachable.
Macro BUG_ON evaluates its condition once and triggers fatal handling only when true, otherwise execution continues normally.

Warning helpers evaluate the condition once and return its truth value. On true they emit a warning tagged with warn taint and the condition text, optionally with a formatted message. Instrumentation guards surround reporting and one path suppresses the separator when the message was already printed.

Once warnings start untriggered, emit on the first true evaluation, then stay silent on later evaluations while still returning the current truth value. One build tracks this with the once flag, the other delegates to a generic do once helper bound to the matching warn operation.

Minimal builds disable reporting and only compute condition truth, discarding formatted messages and aliasing once forms to their plain counterparts. Symmetric multiprocessor warnings equal plain warnings on multiprocessor builds and constant false on uniprocessor builds.

Generic cache layer exports inert defaults for full flush, per mm flush, duplicated mm flush, range flush, page flush, data page flush, mapped data lock and unlock, instruction range flush, user instruction page flush, and virtual map, early map and unmap lifecycle hooks.
User instruction range flush is aliased to the generic instruction range flush. A flag value of zero records that the generic data page flush provides no arch implementation.

Copy to a user page performs an instrumented memcpy then user instruction page maintenance for the written range. Copy from a user page performs an instrumented memcpy with before and after hooks and no cache maintenance.

Checksum fold reduces a 32 bit accumulator to 16 bits using inversion combined with rotated halves. Transport checksum over addresses length protocol and partial sum completes by folding the no fold pseudo header value.

Linker helpers create eight byte aligned kept sections bounded by start and stop symbols, and module variants in dedicated output sections. Allocation tag content appears only when memory allocation profiling is enabled, otherwise the helpers expand to nothing.
COMPAT_USER_HZ is 100, COMPAT_RLIM_INFINITY is 0xffffffff, and COMPAT_OFF_T_MAX is 0x7fffffff.

Compatibility widths are fixed: 16 bit short and unsigned short, 32 bit int unsigned int long unsigned long size offset pid clock timer key mode device ipc pid address and old signal set, 64 bit long long offset and paired 64 bit values, 32 bit uid gid and 32 bit uid32 gid32, 32 bit signal words with 32 bits per word and native signal count, and kernel filesystem id for fsid. Paired 64 bit values use 4 byte alignment in one variant and natural alignment in the other.

A 64 bit compatibility argument is declared as ordered low and high 32 bit halves, with halved order swapped between the two endian variants and a dual form for prototypes. A glue helper rebuilds the 64 bit value from its halves.

Record compat_statfs sequences type, block size, total free and available blocks, total and free files, filesystem id, name length, fragment size, flags and four spares, using 32 bit compatibility integers except for the filesystem id member.

Record compat_ipc64_perm sequences key, uid gid cuid cgid, mode with padding, sequence with padding and two unused words. Semaphore message and shared memory descriptors append split time words with high parts plus object counts sizes and process ids with reserved words.
Delay multipliers scale two to the 32nd power by microsecond and nanosecond rates rounded up. DELAY_CONST_MAX is 20000 and larger constant delays are rejected.

Entries udelay and ndelay accept microsecond and nanosecond lengths. Small compile time constants use precomputed counts, oversize constants fail the build, and variable lengths call the runtime implementations.
Records dev_archdata and pdev_archdata are empty, providing a stable extension point with no members.

Operation do_div divides a 64 bit dividend in place by a 32 bit divisor and returns the 32 bit remainder. The optimized form uses masking and shifting for constant powers of two, reciprocal multiplication for other nonzero constants, narrow division when the high word is zero, and a generic helper otherwise, enforcing 64 bit dividend width.

Constant division precomputes a scaled reciprocal with optional bias to compensate truncation, cancels common low factors, then combines it with the dividend through a 64 bit cross product before final scaling. The cross product uses a simplified accumulation when overflow analysis allows it and a carry tracking accumulation otherwise.
Function get_arch_dma_ops provides the generic direct memory access operations pointer and returns null to indicate no arch specific operations.
MAX_DMA_ADDRESS equals PAGE_OFFSET.
Early mapping exposes init setup and reset operations that default to empty actions on generic builds.
Operation machine_emergency_restart forwards to machine_restart with a null argument.
Error injection distinguishes null, errno, errno or null, and true failure classes in that order. Each whitelist entry pairs a target address with one class value.

Macro ALLOW_ERROR_INJECTION places a persistent whitelist entry in a dedicated section when injection support exists, otherwise it expands to nothing. The function override fallback is an empty hook in the disabled case.

Fixed mapping converts an index to a virtual address by subtracting a page shifted offset from FIXADDR_TOP, and converts back by masking shifting and subtracting. The checked converter enforces the valid fixed address range at build time.
External rotation helper relied upon by checksum folding, owned elsewhere.
Generic cache early mapping and dma defaults do no work, division mutates its dividend, compatibility values truncate outside 32 bit ranges, warnings taint the kernel, and fatal checks never return.
